brief:
Germany's far-left Die Linke party expelled local lawmaker Vanessa Emde on Tuesday over her criticism of Israel, Middle East Eye reported. Emde, a pro-Palestine activist, faced expulsion proceedings initiated by the party over her public statements.

The expulsion reveals internal tensions within Die Linke, a party historically aligned with left-wing causes and pro-Palestine positions. The party's decision shows divisions over how members should address Israeli-Palestinian issues.

title: Germany's Die Linke expels pro-Palestine lawmaker Vanessa Emde
